title: Gold Bar Salts Blueberry Sour Raspberry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Blueberry Sour Raspberry by Gold Bar delivers a vivid fusion of tangy forest fruits with a bright, layered flavour profile. The Blueberry note is sweet and jammy, while the Sour Raspberry adds a sharp, tangy contrast that balances the mix with just the right amount of tartness. This 10ml Nicotine Salt e-liquid is designed for a smooth, tactile inhale with rapid nicotine absorption. Its 50/50 VG/PG ratio makes it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping and is especially well-suited to low-powered pod systems and starter kits. If you love rich, expertly-layered fruit blends or simply enjoy vape juice with a sharper, tart finish, this Gold Bar Nic Salt offers a distinctive flavour combination that’s easy to enjoy throughout the day.
